title: Usage counts: The 1Password Signature Database (1password-signature)
body:
Usage figures for The 1Password Signature Database (1password-signature). USAGE METRICS (all derived from the live manifest data/manifest.json and the data-file inventory; no invented numbers): record_count = the database's record_count field; edition_siblings = other databases in the same edition group (same subject root after stripping signature-/public-/-signature/-public affixes) minus 1; topic_cluster = number of databases sharing the same record_kind; link_count = edition siblings + xdb_pulls entries + (1 if the entry carries a page or page_url); usage_score = round(record_count * (1 + log10(1 + link_count)) + 100 * edition_group_size). Record count: 20. Edition siblings: 1 (same subject, other editions). Topic cluster: 2996 databases share its record kind 'software reference'. Link count: 1 (edition siblings + cross-database pulls + page links). Usage score: 226.

Signature analysis: with a usage score of 226, 1password-signature ranks by computed usage in the system; the score rewards both raw record volume and cross-linkage.
capabilities: Report any database's usage score with full derivation
Rank databases by usage score, record count, or link count
Recompute any figure live from the manifest with the record's demo program
Compare edition siblings by their usage metrics
